Therefore the vulnerable code path is not present in the delivered product.

The target kernel 6.12.96 therefore already contains this fix.
The target kernel version 6.12.95 includes the official upstream fix introduced in Linux 6.12.95. Therefore, this vulnerability has been resolved in the delivered product.
